versions.changelog: Renamed from Ditto to Emulo (v0.5.0). Same tool: mines your local Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode sessions into a working profile. New homepage: github.com/ohad6k/emulo

Ditto-profile 1.0.0 initial release

- Loads a user's Ditto profile from local session logs for a personalized workflow.
- Automatically locates and reads the profile file via `ditto-cli`.
- Guides users to set up a profile if none is found, without inventing one.
- Ensures profiles are only loaded from valid and current locations.
- Keeps all user profile data on the local machine for privacy.
